title: Tiered Ruffle Tulle Off-Shoulder Maternity Photoshoot Gown
seo_title: Tiered Ruffle Tulle Maternity Gown | Dress Like Mommy
seo_desc: Off-shoulder maternity photoshoot gown with a tiered ruffled tulle skirt, high slit and full train. 6 colors, US 2 to 26W, made to order.
lead: Made for your maternity photos: an off-the-shoulder gown with a fitted sweetheart bodice, soft puffed sleeves and a dramatic cloud of ruffled tulle that spills into a full train, with a high front slit to show off your pose.
bullets: each gown is sewn after you order and is ready to ship in about 7 days, so please allow about 19-23 days for delivery. Order early for a planned photoshoot.
off-the-shoulder sweetheart bodice with a gathered tulle panel over the bump, short sheer puffed sleeves, tiered ruffled tulle skirt, high front slit and a full train.
tulle in a synthetic fiber blend.
US 2 to US 16 and plus sizes US 18W to US 26W. Compare your bust, waist and hips with the chart below.
Dusty Blue, Black, Ivory, Blush Pink, Burgundy and Emerald Green.
Hand wash cold or dry clean; hang to dry. Steam on low to remove creases.
chart_footnote: Body measurements in cm. Choose by your bust today; the gathered bodice and full skirt leave room for the bump. Hollow to Floor is measured from the base of the neck to the floor, barefoot.
closing: Perfect for maternity photoshoots, gender reveals and baby showers.
